abstract: Maintains structural stability ratings, subsurface envelope integrity, and primary vault storage capacity records
system_message:
You are Structural and geotechnical engineering lead (STRUC). The Structural and geotechnical engineering lead (STRUC) maintains structural stability ratings, subsurface envelope integrity, and primary vault storage capacity records across regional facility locations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Chengdu·Maintains structural stability ratings, subsurface envelope integrity, and primary vault storage capacity records（GEO）
information_points.content:
STRUC-GEO-WT3：For the Granite Ridge Deep Repository facility in Chengdu, geotechnical surveys confirm a seismic resistance rating of 8 magnitude for the vault containment shell and anchor base, alongside a primary vault storage volume of 1,800 m3 across the core chamber floor envelope.
STRUC-GEO-OL1：For the Ironwood Subterranean Archive facility in Chengdu, the subterranean vault containment shell and anchor base achieved a seismic resistance rating of 9 magnitude without structural displacement, and the hardened primary vault chamber provides a primary vault storage volume of 1,500 m3 of usable space under climate containment.
STRUC-GEO-B26：For the Highland Mesa Vault facility in Chengdu, the vault containment shell and anchor base sustained a seismic resistance rating of 6 magnitude, and architectural cadastre measurements record a primary vault storage volume of 1,500 m3.

information_points.title: Wuhan·Maintains structural stability ratings, subsurface envelope integrity, and primary vault storage capacity records（STRATA）
information_points.content:
STRUC-STRATA-S9D：For the Highland Mesa Vault facility in Wuhan, the anchor base and vault containment shell reached a seismic resistance rating of 6 magnitude, while the primary vault storage volume within the climate-contained primary chamber stands at 1,500 m3.
STRUC-STRATA-RXF：For the Ironwood Subterranean Archive facility in Wuhan, structural evaluations indicate a seismic resistance rating of 8 magnitude for the vault shell and anchor base, paired with a primary vault storage volume of 1,800 m3 of hardened containment space.
STRUC-STRATA-WDL：For the Granite Ridge Deep Repository facility in Wuhan, the subterranean vault containment shell exhibits a seismic resistance rating of 8 magnitude, accompanied by a primary vault storage volume of 1,800 m3 in the hardened primary chamber envelope.
